camel_example: aliyun alidns SearchCloudGtmAddressPools --region cn-hangzhou --AddressPoolName 'AddressPool-1' --PageSize 20 --AddressPoolType IPv4 --PageNumber 1 --EnableStatus enable --AvailableStatus available --HealthStatus ok --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --Remark test
description_en: Searches for address pools by name, remarks, or other criteria
description_zh: 根据传入参数搜索地址池列表
kebab_example: aliyun alidns search-cloud-gtm-address-pools --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --address-pool-name AddressPool-1 --address-pool-type IPv4 --enable-status enable --remark test --health-status ok --available-status available --region cn-hangzhou
name: SearchCloudGtmAddressPools

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh-CN: Chinese.

en-US (default): English
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：

zh-CN：中文。

en-US（默认值）：英文
parameters.name: accept_language

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a unique value from your client for this parameter. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and must be a maximum of 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the address pool. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地址池名称，支持对输入的地址池名称进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: address_pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the address pool. Exact match is supported. Valid values:

IPv4

IPv6

domain
parameters.help_zh:
地址池类型，支持对地址池类型进行精确查询：

IPv4

IPv6

domain
parameters.name: address_pool_type

parameters.help_en:
The status of the address pool. Exact match is supported. Valid values:

enable: The address pool is enabled.

disable: The address pool is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
地址池启用状态，支持对地址池启用状态进行精确查询：

enable：启用状态

disable：禁用状态
parameters.name: enable_status

parameters.help_en: The remarks for the address pool. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 地址池备注，支持对输入的备注进行模糊搜索
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The health status of the address pool. Exact match is supported. Valid values:

ok: Normal. All addresses in the address pool are available.

ok_alert: Warning. Some addresses in the address pool are unavailable, but the address pool is still considered normal. In the warning state, available addresses are resolved as expected, while unavailable addresses are not.

exceptional: Abnormal. Some or all addresses in the address pool are unavailable, and the address pool is considered abnormal
parameters.help_zh:
地址池健康状态，支持对地址池健康状态精确查询：

ok：正常，地址池引用的所有地址全部可用。

ok_alert：警告，地址池引用的地址部分不可用，但是地址池状态判定为正常。警告状态下，可用的地址池正常解析，不可用的地址池停止解析。

exceptional：异常，地址池引用的地址部分或全部不可用，地址池状态判定为异常
parameters.name: health_status

parameters.help_en:
The availability of the address pool. Exact match is supported. Valid values:

available: The address pool is available.

unavailable: The address pool is unavailable
parameters.help_zh:
地址池可用状态，支持对地址池可用状态进行精确查询：

available：可用

unavailable：不可用
parameters.name: available_status
